target_customer: Audit, accounting, tax and advisory firms that need to collect documents from their clients
problem: Auditors and accountants spend weeks chasing clients by email for thousands of documents. UpLink gives each request a tracked workflow with reminders.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription for firms; after acquisition sold as an add-on to the DataSnipper platform
product_category: Document request and PBC (prepared by client) collection software

founders.name: Alexander Maher
founders.background_notes: Started as a CPA doing IT audits at a Big 4 firm, taught himself to code, then led software development at a public telecom construction company.

founders.name: Alexander Grant
founders.background_notes: Helped scale PwC's data analytics platform to 20k global users.

founders.name: Brady Ochse
education: Computer science at a large public university (unnamed)

founders.name: Nicholas Yarmesch
education: Computer science at a large public university (unnamed)

technical_complexity.rationale: A workflow and file upload SaaS with notifications. Standard web engineering for a four person team with engineering backgrounds; the later AI validation layer was added after acquisition.

defensibility.rationale: Features are easy to copy and clients can switch portals between engagements. Some stickiness comes from firms embedding the portal in each audit cycle and the founders' audit domain knowledge.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: DataSnipper, an audit automation vendor, bought UpLink in October 2024 and folded it in as its AI powered PBC portal.

market_need_then: Audit busy season requires collecting thousands of client documents by email and spreadsheet; the founders lived this at PwC. Evidence is from founder accounts on the YC page, not from third party spend data.

branding.domain_note: Used uplinkapp.io rather than an exact .com; no purchase story found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Confident, direct and benefit focused, enterprise tone, as seen on the DataSnipper hosted product page.

rebrands.why: Acquisition; product kept its name under the acquirer.

brand_strength.rationale: No press about the brand itself and no community found; the name is shared with unrelated companies, so it is forgettable.

outcome_analysis: UpLink was founded by former PwC auditors and engineers who knew the document chasing pain first hand, joined YC in Summer 2022, and was acquired by audit automation company DataSnipper in October 2024 for an undisclosed price. No funding beyond YC is public, so the exit looks capital efficient but the size is unknown.
notes: No funding amounts found. A VCBacked page showing $10M total belongs to a different UpLink and was ignored. Competitor sources found were all dated 2025 vendor marketing, so the founding era competitor list is empty. YC lists founded 2021 while sources say the company started in 2022. Completeness pass 2026-11: a $125K round dated 2022-06 is recorded; it rests on a single database (TheCompanyCheck) and matches YC's standard deal. CB Insights instead shows $500K over 3 rounds, unreconciled, so coverage is partial. No press states UpLink's funding.
